evidence.title: Explore all coded visuals and illustrations - CodedVisuals

name: CodedVisuals
summary: Index of 122 animated, copy-paste coded illustrations for React and shadcn/ui, with 1150+ ready-made variations across 32 categories.
description: CodedVisuals is a library of animated visual compositions: self-contained React components you drop into marketing sites and landing pages instead of static illustration packs. Every composition is a single typed .tsx file styled with shadcn/ui design tokens, animated with Motion, and installable through the shadcn registry or CLI; light and dark mode come free.
contains: 122 animated coded illustrations with 1150+ ready-made variations across 32 categories
install through the shadcn registry or CLI, or copy the code by hand
single-file React + TypeScript components styled with shadcn/ui tokens, Tailwind CSS v4 and Motion
visual groups include charts, AI agent UI, chat, calendar, avatars, data, integrations and page sections
AI Skills package and shadcn MCP server support included
pricing: Solo $69 one-time (launch price, $99 after) and Team license; lifetime updates
5 compositions published on GitHub as a free sample
sold under Solo and Team licenses for unlimited personal and commercial projects
